title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro / Language Support
slide_intent: Make language coverage inspectable so a consistent visual voice does not exclude a needed language.
strategic_value: An explicit language list can help Helsinki plan multilingual typography and identify fallback needs.
demonstration: Narrow columns list Latin-script languages and a shorter Cyrillic-script group under the Language Support title.
practical_value: Verify that a target language is listed and check its actual required glyphs.

content_islands.name: Latin language inventory
content_islands.spec: Multiple narrow columns carry the long alphabetical list.

content_islands.name: Cyrillic language inventory
content_islands.spec: A separate labeled group at right lists supported Cyrillic languages.
